title: One Puff Left
rule: Pip has one jetpack burst for the entire episode. It cannot be refilled during the delivery.

scenes.action: Pip catches the loose metal lid. The cake drifts toward a fan.
Pip fires her last burst and catches the cake.
Pip throws the metal lid away from the hatch. The recoil carries her back.

revision_test.instruction: Keep the first two scenes. Give the ending a stronger visual joke.

rejected_candidate.action: Pip fires her jetpack again and rockets back to the hatch.
